current_example:
Assume countable choice.
On $(0,1)$ with Euclidean distance and density $x^{-1}|dx|$, the ball $B(1/2,1/4)$ has volume $\log3$, whereas $B(1/2,1)=(0,1)$ has infinite volume. Both are Borel and positive in volume.
